p: Put events, tables and documents where agents can query them — and keep every answer tied to the query, the file or the assertion it came from.
Datastore keeps each column in its own compressed file, so a query reads only the columns it names. It speaks a ClickHouse-compatible HTTP API and ingests JSONEachRow and Parquet.
Insights captures events, funnels and retention, and hands you SQL when a chart cannot say it. The flag that shipped the change and the replay of someone using it sit beside the metric.

The memory graph records each assertion with who said it and when it was true, and never overwrites one. Ask a question and the answer cites what it rests on; ask as of last quarter and you get last quarter.
Push documents once. Full text finds the exact string, vectors find what you described, and one request runs both.
Lease a sandbox for the organization, run Python against the extract, and give it back. A paused machine meters nothing.
